# invoice-kit

**Patient bills for the lab: exact to the paisa, printed on the same letterhead as the reports.**

Tests · packages · services · consumables · medicines · GST · discounts · split payments · amount in words

[![Backend](https://img.shields.io/badge/side-backend-14264A)](#)

## What you get

- **Every kind of line item:** lab tests, health packages, services (home collection, urgent report),
  consumables and medicines, each with qty, rate, % or flat discount, optional GST % / HSN / batch note.
- **Bill-level discount** (% or flat, with a reason), shared across lines *before* tax.
- **GST per rate.** Discount and GST columns appear only when used; lab tests are usually exempt.
- **Round-off, grand total and amount in words** in the Indian system (lakh / crore).
- **Payments:** split Cash/UPI/Card/…, paid, balance due or refund, and a **PAID · PARTIALLY PAID · DUE** stamp.
- **Codes:** Code 128 barcode of the invoice number, plus a **UPI scan-to-pay QR** when the lab sets its UPI ID.
- **Same letterhead as the reports**, header and non-header (pre-printed paper), multi-page with *Page X of Y*.
- **One API for everything:** `createMgplApi()` serves invoice *and* report routes.

## Quick start

```bash
npm i @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit react react-dom
```

```ts
import { buildInvoice, computeInvoice, renderInvoicePdf } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";

const invoice = buildInvoice({
  invoiceNo: "MGPL/2026-27/0399",
  patient: { title: "Mr", name: "Ramesh Kumar Verma", age: 67, sex: "Male", patientId: "MGPL1024" },
  items: [
    "full-body-checkup",                                  // price-list code
    "home-collection",
    { code: "syringe-5ml", qty: 2 },                      // code + overrides
    { name: "Special stain", category: "test", rate: 450 }, // free-form line
  ],
  discount: { percent: 10, reason: "Senior citizen" },
  payments: [{ mode: "UPI", amount: 2000, reference: "UTR 428615903317" }],
});

computeInvoice(invoice);   // { total, due, status: "PARTIALLY PAID", taxByRate, … }
const pdf = await renderInvoicePdf({ invoice, variant: "header" });
```

## One backend for reports and invoices

```ts
// Next.js — app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
import { createMgplApi } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";
const api = createMgplApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" });
export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };
export const runtime = "nodejs";
```

```ts
// Fastify
import { mgplFastify } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify";
await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl" });
```

```ts
// Express / node:http
import { toNodeHandler } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createMgplApi()));
```

Frontends call it with [`@mgpl-diagnostics/client`](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client):
`client.invoices.totals(invoice)`, `client.invoices.pdf({ invoice })`, …

## HTTP API

| Method & route | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /invoice` | `{ invoice, variant, format: "pdf" \| "html" \| "json" }` | PDF, HTML, or the full calculation as JSON |
| `GET /price-list` | | `[{ code, name, category, rate, taxPercent?, hsn? }]` |
| `GET /invoice-samples` | | demo invoices (only with `samples: true`) |
| *all report-kit routes* | | `/templates`, `/report`, `/letterhead`, `/assets/*`, `/health` |

Invalid input (missing patient, unknown price code, negative rate…) returns `400 { "error": "…" }`.

## How the maths works

All arithmetic is in **integer paise**, so totals never drift by a paisa.

1. line gross = qty × rate
2. line discount (percent wins over a flat amount)
3. bill discount, shared across lines in proportion (largest-remainder, so the shares add up exactly)
4. GST on what remains, grouped by rate
5. round-off to the nearest rupee (unless `roundOff: false`)

The **Amount** column shows `qty × rate − line discount`; bill discount, GST and round-off appear in the totals.
The smoke test checks these against hand-computed values on every run.

## Price list

[`src/price-list.ts`](src/price-list.ts) maps codes → `{ name, category, rate, taxPercent?, hsn? }`. Test codes are the
report-kit template ids, so `itemsForTests(["cbc", "kft"])` bills a report's tests.

> **The rates shipped here are sample placeholders.** Pass your real list with `buildInvoice({ …, priceList })`,
> or edit the file, and have your accountant confirm GST rates and HSN codes.

Lab settings in report-kit's lab profile: `upiId` (scan-to-pay QR), `gstin` and `registrationNo` (under the title),
`invoiceTerms` (printed under the payments).

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm run smoke      # arithmetic checks + every sample as HTML & PDF, values verified inside the PDFs
npm run test:api   # the HTTP API, the client SDK, Fastify and node:http end to end
npm run examples   # examples/index.html
```

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the money and rendering rules, [docs/api.md](docs/api.md) for the full API,
and [llms.txt](llms.txt) / [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) for AI tools.

## File: docs/api.md

# API reference: @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit (v2)

Backend only (Node.js ≥ 20); peer dependency `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit` ^2.
Entry points: `@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit` and `@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify`.

## HTTP API: reports and invoices in one handler

```ts
createMgplApi(opts?: ApiOptions): (req: Request) => Promise<Response>   // ApiOptions from report-kit
createInvoiceRoutes(opts?): (req: Request) => Promise<Response | null>  // invoice routes only (null = not mine)

// Fastify
import { mgplFastify } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify";
await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl" });
```

| Route | Notes |
|---|---|
| `POST /invoice` | body `InvoiceRequest` → PDF (default), HTML (`format: "html"`) or the calculation (`format: "json"`) |
| `GET /price-list` | `[{ code, name, category, rate, taxPercent?, hsn? }]` |
| `GET /invoice-samples` | `[{ id, label, invoiceNo }]` (only with `samples: true`) |
| all report-kit routes | `/health`, `/templates`, `/samples`, `/report`, `/letterhead`, `/assets/*` |

```ts
interface InvoiceRequest {
  invoice?: BuildInvoiceInput;   // items may be codes, code + overrides, or full items
  sample?: string;
  variant?: "header" | "non-header";
  format?: "pdf" | "html" | "json";
  fileName?: string; download?: boolean;
}
```

Validation (400): `invoiceNo`, `patient.name/age/sex`, non-empty `items` (≤ 500), known price codes,
`rate ≥ 0`, `qty > 0`, `taxPercent` 0–100, `payments[].amount ≥ 0`.
`invoiceFromRequest(body, opts)` and `invoiceTotalsJson(invoice)` are exported for custom routes.

## Billing

```ts
buildInvoice(input: BuildInvoiceInput): Invoice
interface BuildInvoiceInput {
  invoiceNo: string; date?: Date | string; patient: Patient;
  items: ItemInput[];   // "cbc" | { code: "cbc", qty?, rate?, discountPercent?, … } | InvoiceItem
  discount?: { percent?: number; amount?: number; reason?: string };
  payments?: Payment[]; notes?: string[]; roundOff?: boolean; title?: string;
  priceList?: Record<string, PriceEntry>;
}
itemsForTests(ids: string[]): ItemInput[]

interface InvoiceItem {
  code?: string; name: string; category: "test" | "profile" | "medicine" | "consumable" | "service" | "other";
  qty?: number; rate: number; discountPercent?: number; discountAmount?: number;
  taxPercent?: number; hsn?: string; note?: string;
}
interface Payment { mode: string; amount: number; date?: Date | string; reference?: string }

computeInvoice(inv): InvoiceTotals
// { lines, subtotal, lineDiscount, billDiscount, taxable, tax, taxByRate, roundOff, total,
//   paid, due, excess, status: "PAID" | "PARTIALLY PAID" | "DUE", hasTax, hasDiscount }
money(n)            // "1,23,456.50"
amountInWords(n)    // "Rupees One Lakh … Only"
CURRENCY            // "Rs."
PRICE_LIST, INVOICE_SAMPLES, CATEGORY_LABEL, INVOICE_LAYOUT
```

## Rendering

```ts
renderInvoicePdf({ invoice, variant, lab?, publicDir? }): Promise<Buffer>
renderInvoiceHtml({ invoice, variant, lab?, inline? = true, fontBase? }): Promise<string>
<InvoiceDocument invoice variant lab? includeStyles? fontBase? />    // React, rendered on the server
InvoicePdf                                                           // react-pdf <Document>
invoicePages(inv, lab), invoiceQr(inv, totals, lab)                  // shared page split / QR value
```

## File: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit

Instructions for AI coding agents and developers. Read
[report-kit's AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/blob/main/AGENTS.md) too:
the same rendering rules apply.

## What this is

The **backend** library (Node.js ≥ 20) for patient invoices. Each invoice is rendered twice, identically:
- **HTML:** `src/InvoiceDocument.tsx`, a pure React component;
- **PDF:** `src/InvoicePdf.tsx`, react-pdf.

It also owns **`createMgplApi()`**, the single HTTP handler for reports *and* invoices (report-kit's
routes plus `/invoice`, `/price-list`, `/invoice-samples`), and the Fastify plugin that wraps it.

The letterhead layer, fonts, assets, barcode, QR, HTTP helpers and `defaultLab()` (real signatures from
env files) come from `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit`, which is a peer dependency. There is no browser code
here; frontends use `@mgpl-diagnostics/client`.

## Map

```
src/
  index.ts        package entry (everything except the Fastify plugin)
  fastify.ts      "/fastify" entry: mgplFastify → createMgplApi
  api.ts          createMgplApi, createInvoiceRoutes, invoiceFromRequest (validation), invoiceTotalsJson
  types.ts        Invoice, InvoiceItem, Payment, ItemCategory, PaymentStatus
  calc.ts         computeInvoice (integer paise), money(), amountInWords() (Indian lakh/crore)
  price-list.ts   PRICE_LIST — SAMPLE prices; codes = report-kit template/profile ids + services/consumables/medicines
  build.ts        buildInvoice (codes → lines, overrides), itemsForTests
  layout.ts       geometry (inches/pt), shared by both renderers
  model.ts        display logic: grouped rows, dynamic columns, totals lines, cards, QR, pagination
  styles.ts       CSS (report-kit sidebarCss + invoice parts)
  InvoiceDocument.tsx / InvoicePdf.tsx
  pdf.ts          renderInvoicePdf
  server.ts       renderInvoiceHtml
  samples.ts      INVOICE_SAMPLES (fictional)
scripts/          smoke-test.tsx, api-test.ts (HTTP + client + Fastify + node:http), generate-examples.tsx
dist/             build output — git-ignored; built by `prepare` and in CI
```

## Money rules

- All arithmetic in `calc.ts` uses **integer paise**. Do not add float maths elsewhere. Format with `money()`.
- Order of operations:
  1. line gross = qty × rate;
  2. line discount (percent wins over amount);
  3. bill discount, shared in proportion with the largest-remainder rule so the shares add up exactly;
  4. GST on what remains;
  5. round-off to the rupee (unless `roundOff: false`).
- The Amount column shows `qty × rate − line discount`. Bill discount, GST and round-off appear only in the totals.
- Status: `PAID` if paid ≥ total, `PARTIALLY PAID` if 0 < paid < total, otherwise `DUE`; `excess` = refund.
- Currency is written `Rs.`, because the Manrope font has no `₹` glyph.

## Rendering rules (react-pdf)

- Every fixed-height row needs `lineHeight: 1` on its texts. Text taller than its box is **silently
  dropped**. The info cards once lost all their values this way; the smoke test now checks that every
  value is present in the PDF text.
- Card rows must fit: `5 × INV_CARDS.lineH + 2 × pad ≤ INV_CARDS.h` (checked by smoke).
- Column widths come from `invoiceColumns()`. Discount and GST columns appear only when used; the
  description column takes the remaining width.
- Pagination (`invoicePages`) keeps group headings with their first item and keeps the totals
  block whole on the last page.

## Commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run smoke   # required before committing
npm run test:api                     # required when api.ts or the HTTP contract changes
npm run build                        # dist/ (git-ignored)
npm run examples                     # inspect PDFs visually
```

## Contract with the client

`InvoiceRequest` / `invoiceTotalsJson()` are mirrored in `@mgpl-diagnostics/client` (`InvoiceInput`,
`InvoiceTotals`). report-studio's `contract-check.ts` fails its typecheck if they drift; change both repos together.

## Privacy and licence

Never commit real patient or billing data, or real signatures. Samples use fictional names.
The code is "All rights reserved" (see LICENSE).

## File: src/types.ts

```ts
import type { Patient } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

export type ItemCategory = "test" | "profile" | "medicine" | "consumable" | "service" | "other";

/** One billed line. Money is in rupees (decimals allowed); maths is done in paise. */
export interface InvoiceItem {
  /** Price-list code, e.g. "cbc", "home-collection" */
  code?: string;
  name: string;
  category: ItemCategory;
  /** Default 1 */
  qty?: number;
  /** Unit price, rupees */
  rate: number;
  /** Line discount as a percentage of qty × rate … */
  discountPercent?: number;
  /** … or as a flat amount (rupees). Percent wins if both are set. */
  discountAmount?: number;
  /** GST %, e.g. 12 for consumables. Lab tests are usually exempt (0). */
  taxPercent?: number;
  /** HSN / SAC code, printed under the item */
  hsn?: string;
  /** Small note under the item, e.g. batch / expiry for medicines */
  note?: string;
}

export interface Payment {
  /** "Cash" | "UPI" | "Card" | "Online" | "Cheque" | … */
  mode: string;
  amount: number;
  date?: Date | string;
  /** Transaction / UTR / cheque number */
  reference?: string;
}

export interface Invoice {
  invoiceNo: string;
  /** Defaults to today */
  date?: Date | string;
  patient: Patient;
  items: InvoiceItem[];
  /** Bill-level discount, applied before tax and shared across the lines in proportion */
  discount?: { percent?: number; amount?: number; reason?: string };
  payments?: Payment[];
  /** Printed under the payment details */
  notes?: string[];
  /** Round the grand total to the nearest rupee (default true) */
  roundOff?: boolean;
  /** Heading, default "INVOICE" */
  title?: string;
}

export type PaymentStatus = "PAID" | "PARTIALLY PAID" | "DUE";
```

## File: src/api.ts

```ts
// Invoice routes + createMgplApi(): ONE backend handler for reports AND invoices.
import {
  apiBaseUrl,
  createReportApi,
  DEFAULT_BASE_PATH,
  HttpError,
  htmlResponse,
  json,
  labWithAssetUrls,
  defaultLab,
  pdfResponse,
  readJson,
  withCors,
  type ApiHandler,
  type ApiOptions,
  type ReportVariant,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { buildInvoice, type BuildInvoiceInput } from "./build";
import { amountInWords, computeInvoice } from "./calc";
import { renderInvoicePdf } from "./pdf";
import { PRICE_LIST } from "./price-list";
import { INVOICE_SAMPLES } from "./samples";
import { renderInvoiceHtml } from "./server";
import type { Invoice } from "./types";

export const INVOICE_ROUTES = { invoice: "/invoice", priceList: "/price-list", invoiceSamples: "/invoice-samples" } as const;

/** POST /invoice body */
export interface InvoiceRequest {
  /** Same shape as buildInvoice(): items may be price-list codes, code + overrides, or full items */
  invoice?: BuildInvoiceInput;
  /** demo id (only when the server enables samples) */
  sample?: string;
  variant?: ReportVariant;
  /** default "pdf"; "json" returns the calculation */
  format?: "pdf" | "html" | "json";
  fileName?: string;
  download?: boolean;
}

const num = (v: unknown) => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);

/** Validates and builds an Invoice from a request (HttpError 400 on bad input). */
export function invoiceFromRequest(body: InvoiceRequest, opts: Pick<ApiOptions, "samples"> = {}): Invoice {
  try {
    if (body.sample) {
      if (!opts.samples) throw new Error("samples are disabled on this server");
      const s = INVOICE_SAMPLES.find((x) => x.id === body.sample);
      if (!s) throw new Error(`unknown sample "${body.sample}"`);
      return s.invoice;
    }
    const inv = body.invoice;
    if (!inv) throw new Error("send invoice or sample");
    if (!inv.invoiceNo || typeof inv.invoiceNo !== "string") throw new Error("invoice.invoiceNo is required");
    if (!inv.patient?.name || inv.patient.age == null || !inv.patient.sex) throw new Error("invoice.patient needs name, age and sex");
    if (!Array.isArray(inv.items) || !inv.items.length) throw new Error("invoice.items must be a non-empty array");
    if (inv.items.length > 500) throw new Error("too many items");
    const built = buildInvoice(inv);
    for (const [k, it] of built.items.entries()) {
      if (!num(it.rate) || it.rate < 0) throw new Error(`items[${k}].rate must be a number >= 0`);
      if (it.qty != null && (!num(it.qty) || it.qty <= 0)) throw new Error(`items[${k}].qty must be > 0`);
      if (it.taxPercent != null && (!num(it.taxPercent) || it.taxPercent < 0 || it.taxPercent > 100)) throw new Error(`items[${k}].taxPercent must be 0-100`);
    }
    for (const [k, p] of (built.payments ?? []).entries()) if (!num(p.amount) || p.amount < 0) throw new Error(`payments[${k}].amount must be a number >= 0`);
    return built;
  } catch (e) {
    throw new HttpError(400, (e as Error).message);
  }
}

/** The server's calculation as JSON (what POST /invoice returns with format "json"). */
export function invoiceTotalsJson(inv: Invoice) {
  const t = computeInvoice(inv);
  return {
    ...t,
    lines: t.lines.map((l) => ({
      index: l.index,
      name: l.item.name,
      qty: l.qty,
      gross: l.gross,
      lineDiscount: l.lineDiscount,
      billDiscount: l.billDiscount,
      taxable: l.taxable,
      tax: l.tax,
      amount: l.amount,
    })),
    amountInWords: amountInWords(t.total),
  };
}

/** Invoice routes only. Returns null for paths it doesn't own (so it can be combined). */
export function createInvoiceRoutes(opts: ApiOptions = {}) {
  const base = (opts.basePath ?? DEFAULT_BASE_PATH).replace(/\/$/, "");
  const lab = opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
  const max = opts.maxBodyBytes ?? 1_000_000;
  return async (req: Request): Promise<Response | null> => {
    let path = new URL(req.url).pathname;
    if (path.startsWith(base)) path = path.slice(base.length) || "/";
    const get = req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD";
    if (path === INVOICE_ROUTES.priceList && get) return json(Object.entries(PRICE_LIST).map(([code, e]) => ({ code, ...e })));
    if (path === INVOICE_ROUTES.invoiceSamples && get) {
      if (!opts.samples) throw new HttpError(404, "samples are disabled on this server");
      return json(INVOICE_SAMPLES.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: s.label, invoiceNo: s.invoice.invoiceNo })));
    }
    if (path !== INVOICE_ROUTES.invoice) return null;
    if (req.method !== "POST") throw new HttpError(405, "Use POST");
    const body = await readJson<InvoiceRequest>(req, max);
    const invoice = invoiceFromRequest(body, opts);
    const variant: ReportVariant = body.variant === "non-header" ? "non-header" : "header";
    if (body.format === "json") return json(invoiceTotalsJson(invoice));
    if (body.format === "html") {
      const assetBase = apiBaseUrl(req, opts) + "/assets";
      return htmlResponse(await renderInvoiceHtml({ invoice, variant, lab: labWithAssetUrls(lab, assetBase), inline: false, fontBase: `${assetBase}/report-fonts` }));
    }
    return pdfResponse(await renderInvoicePdf({ invoice, variant, lab }), body.fileName ?? `${invoice.invoiceNo}.pdf`, !!body.download);
  };
}

/**
 * ONE backend for reports + invoices (all report-kit routes plus /invoice, /price-list).
 *
 *   // Next.js  app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
 *   const api = createMgplApi();
 *   export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };  export const runtime = "nodejs";
 *
 *   // Fastify   app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl" })      (from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify")
 *   // Express   app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createMgplApi()))
 */
export function createMgplApi(opts: ApiOptions = {}): ApiHandler {
  const reports = createReportApi(opts);
  const invoices = createInvoiceRoutes(opts);
  return async (req) => {
    if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return reports(req);
    try {
      const res = await invoices(req);
      if (res) return withCors(res, opts.cors);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof HttpError) return withCors(json({ error: e.message }, e.status), opts.cors);
      console.error("[@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit]", e);
      return withCors(json({ error: "Internal error" }, 500), opts.cors);
    }
    return reports(req);
  };
}
```

## File: src/calc.ts

```ts
// Invoice arithmetic. Everything is done in integer paise so totals never drift by a paisa.
import type { Invoice, InvoiceItem, PaymentStatus } from "./types";

const P = (rupees: number) => Math.round(rupees * 100);
const R = (paise: number) => paise / 100;

export interface ComputedLine {
  item: InvoiceItem;
  index: number;
  qty: number;
  /** qty × rate */
  gross: number;
  lineDiscount: number;
  /** share of the bill-level discount */
  billDiscount: number;
  /** gross − discounts */
  taxable: number;
  tax: number;
  /** taxable + tax */
  amount: number;
}

export interface InvoiceTotals {
  lines: ComputedLine[];
  /** Σ qty × rate */
  subtotal: number;
  lineDiscount: number;
  billDiscount: number;
  taxable: number;
  tax: number;
  /** tax grouped by rate, e.g. [{ rate: 12, taxable: 100, tax: 12 }] */
  taxByRate: { rate: number; taxable: number; tax: number }[];
  roundOff: number;
  total: number;
  paid: number;
  /** total − paid, never negative */
  due: number;
  /** paid − total when overpaid (refund / change) */
  excess: number;
  status: PaymentStatus;
  hasTax: boolean;
  hasDiscount: boolean;
}

export function computeInvoice(inv: Invoice): InvoiceTotals {
  // 1. line gross and line discount
  const base = inv.items.map((item, index) => {
    const qty = item.qty ?? 1;
    const gross = Math.round(qty * P(item.rate));
    const disc =
      item.discountPercent != null ? Math.round((gross * item.discountPercent) / 100) : Math.min(gross, P(item.discountAmount ?? 0));
    return { item, index, qty, gross, lineDiscount: disc, afterLine: gross - disc };
  });

  // 2. bill discount, shared in proportion to each line's value (largest-remainder so it adds up exactly)
  const pool = base.reduce((a, l) => a + l.afterLine, 0);
  const wanted = inv.discount?.percent != null ? Math.round((pool * inv.discount.percent) / 100) : P(inv.discount?.amount ?? 0);
  const billTotal = Math.min(pool, Math.max(0, wanted));
  const shares = base.map((l) => (pool ? (billTotal * l.afterLine) / pool : 0));
  const floors = shares.map(Math.floor);
  let left = billTotal - floors.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  shares
    .map((s, i) => ({ i, frac: s - Math.floor(s) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.frac - a.frac)
    .forEach(({ i }) => {
      if (left > 0) {
        floors[i]++;
        left--;
      }
    });

  // 3. tax on what is left
  const lines = base.map((l, i) => {
    const taxable = l.afterLine - floors[i];
    const tax = Math.round((taxable * (l.item.taxPercent ?? 0)) / 100);
    return { ...l, billDiscount: floors[i], taxable, tax, amount: taxable + tax };
  });

  const sum = (f: (l: (typeof lines)[number]) => number) => lines.reduce((a, l) => a + f(l), 0);
  const exact = sum((l) => l.amount);
  const total = inv.roundOff === false ? exact : Math.round(exact / 100) * 100;
  const paid = (inv.payments ?? []).reduce((a, p) => a + P(p.amount), 0);

  const byRate = new Map<number, { taxable: number; tax: number }>();
  for (const l of lines) {
    const rate = l.item.taxPercent ?? 0;
    if (!rate) continue;
    const e = byRate.get(rate) ?? { taxable: 0, tax: 0 };
    e.taxable += l.taxable;
    e.tax += l.tax;
    byRate.set(rate, e);
  }

  const status: PaymentStatus = paid >= total ? "PAID" : paid > 0 ? "PARTIALLY PAID" : "DUE";
  return {
    lines: lines.map((l) => ({
      item: l.item,
      index: l.index,
      qty: l.qty,
      gross: R(l.gross),
      lineDiscount: R(l.lineDiscount),
      billDiscount: R(l.billDiscount),
      taxable: R(l.taxable),
      tax: R(l.tax),
      amount: R(l.amount),
    })),
    subtotal: R(sum((l) => l.gross)),
    lineDiscount: R(sum((l) => l.lineDiscount)),
    billDiscount: R(billTotal),
    taxable: R(sum((l) => l.taxable)),
    tax: R(sum((l) => l.tax)),
    taxByRate: [...byRate.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]).map(([rate, e]) => ({ rate, taxable: R(e.taxable), tax: R(e.tax) })),
    roundOff: R(total - exact),
    total: R(total),
    paid: R(paid),
    due: R(Math.max(0, total - paid)),
    excess: R(Math.max(0, paid - total)),
    status,
    hasTax: lines.some((l) => (l.item.taxPercent ?? 0) > 0),
    hasDiscount: sum((l) => l.lineDiscount) > 0 || billTotal > 0,
  };
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- formatting */

const inr = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
/** 123456.5 → "1,23,456.50" (Indian digit grouping) */
export const money = (n: number) => inr.format(n);
export const CURRENCY = "Rs.";

const ONES = ["", "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine", "Ten", "Eleven", "Twelve", "Thirteen", "Fourteen", "Fifteen", "Sixteen", "Seventeen", "Eighteen", "Nineteen"];
const TENS = ["", "", "Twenty", "Thirty", "Forty", "Fifty", "Sixty", "Seventy", "Eighty", "Ninety"];

function upTo99(n: number) {
  return n < 20 ? ONES[n] : `${TENS[Math.floor(n / 10)]}${n % 10 ? " " + ONES[n % 10] : ""}`;
}
function upTo999(n: number) {
  const h = Math.floor(n / 100);
  const r = n % 100;
  return [h ? `${ONES[h]} Hundred` : "", r ? upTo99(r) : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

/** Indian numbering: 123456.78 → "Rupees One Lakh Twenty Three Thousand Four Hundred Fifty Six and Seventy Eight Paise Only" */
export function amountInWords(amount: number): string {
  const paise = Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 100);
  let r = Math.floor(paise / 100);
  const p = paise % 100;
  if (r === 0 && p === 0) return "Rupees Zero Only";
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const crore = Math.floor(r / 1e7);
  r %= 1e7;
  const lakh = Math.floor(r / 1e5);
  r %= 1e5;
  const thousand = Math.floor(r / 1000);
  r %= 1000;
  if (crore) parts.push(`${crore >= 100 ? upTo999(crore) : upTo99(crore)} Crore`);
  if (lakh) parts.push(`${upTo99(lakh)} Lakh`);
  if (thousand) parts.push(`${upTo99(thousand)} Thousand`);
  if (r) parts.push(upTo999(r));
  const rupees = parts.length ? `Rupees ${parts.join(" ")}` : "Rupees Zero";
  return `${rupees}${p ? ` and ${upTo99(p)} Paise` : ""} Only`;
}
```


---

## File: src/build.ts

```ts
import type { Patient } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { PRICE_LIST, type PriceEntry } from "./price-list";
import type { Invoice, InvoiceItem, Payment } from "./types";

/** A line given by price-list code (with optional overrides) or written out in full. */
export type ItemInput = string | (Partial<InvoiceItem> & { code: string }) | InvoiceItem;

export interface BuildInvoiceInput {
  invoiceNo: string;
  date?: Date | string;
  patient: Patient;
  items: ItemInput[];
  discount?: Invoice["discount"];
  payments?: Payment[];
  notes?: string[];
  roundOff?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  /** Use a different price list (defaults to PRICE_LIST) */
  priceList?: Record<string, PriceEntry>;
}

/**
 *   buildInvoice({
 *     invoiceNo: "INV-2026-0042", patient,
 *     items: ["cbc", "lft", { code: "home-collection" }, { code: "syringe-5ml", qty: 2 }],
 *     discount: { percent: 10, reason: "Senior citizen" },
 *     payments: [{ mode: "UPI", amount: 500, reference: "UTR 4521…" }],
 *   })
 */
export function buildInvoice(input: BuildInvoiceInput): Invoice {
  const list = input.priceList ?? PRICE_LIST;
  const items = input.items.map((it): InvoiceItem => {
    if (typeof it === "string") it = { code: it };
    if ("name" in it && "rate" in it && "category" in it && it.name && it.rate != null && it.category) return it as InvoiceItem;
    const code = (it as { code: string }).code;
    const entry = list[code];
    if (!entry) throw new Error(`Unknown price-list code "${code}"`);
    return { ...entry, ...it, code } as InvoiceItem;
  });
  return {
    invoiceNo: input.invoiceNo,
    date: input.date,
    patient: input.patient,
    items,
    discount: input.discount,
    payments: input.payments,
    notes: input.notes,
    roundOff: input.roundOff,
    title: input.title,
  };
}

/** Bill the tests on a report: template / profile ids → invoice lines. */
export const itemsForTests = (ids: string[]): ItemInput[] => ids.map((code) => ({ code }));
```
